title: Illusion Momentum Cross-Sectional Signal on H198 30-Stock Large-Cap Universe
description: Test the 'Illusion Momentum' signal introduced by Iwanaga & Hirose (Pacific-Basin Finance Journal, Vol 96, 2026, DOI: 10.1016/j.pacfin.2026.103063) on the H198 30-stock large-cap universe. The signal exploits investors' tendency to mistake cumulative-sum returns (arithmetic sum of periodic returns) for cumulative returns (geometric compound return). Formula: ILLUSION = Σ(r_t) − [Π(1+r_t) − 1], where both sums run over the same T-month formation window. The gap is always ≥ 0 (Jensen's inequality: arithmetic mean ≥ geometric mean) and grows with return variance. Key insight: stocks with higher illusion momentum have been MORE volatile during the formation period, and investors cognitively anchor on the arithmetic sum — which overstates the true wealth gain — creating underreaction and future drift upward. Paper confirms the signal in both Japanese and US markets, with stronger effects in bear markets and among large-cap equities. Implementation: (1) Compute 6-month Illusion Momentum = 6m_arithmetic_sum − 6m_compound_return for each of the 30 H198 stocks monthly; (2) test as standalone ranking signal (top-1, top-2, top-3); (3) test as tiebreaker composite blended with H377 6-0m no-skip momentum; (4) test with SPY 200MA overlay. Gate: OOS Sharpe > 1.174 (H198 baseline) AND MaxDD > −30%. IS: 2013-2020, OOS: 2021-2026. Script: backtesting/daily/run_h385.py (to be written).
rationale: The H198 30-stock large-cap universe is exactly where the authors confirm significance — large-cap US equities in bear markets. The signal is mechanically computable from monthly OHLCV data at zero additional cost (same data already used for H198/H377). Crucially, Illusion Momentum is orthogonal to H377 6-0m no-skip momentum: H377 removes the skip month from the standard geometric return; H385 instead uses the arithmetic-geometric gap as a distinct signal. The two signals could be complementary. The mechanism (cognitive bias around return aggregation) is intuitive and consistent with behavioral finance literature on investor underreaction. If confirmed, this would add a third orthogonal momentum signal to the H198 universe (standard 6-1m, no-skip 6-0m, and illusion), potentially enabling a composite that further improves OOS Sharpe beyond 3.075.
source_paper: Iwanaga & Hirose (2026), Pacific-Basin Finance Journal Vol 96, DOI: 10.1016/j.pacfin.2026.103063
